item.title: Issue #3005 created
item.description:
`fn:build-uri`: UNCs

The URI functions currently break the UNC round trip:

let $options := { 'unc-path': true() }
return 'file:////uncname/path' => parse-uri($options) => build-uri($options)

…returns file://////uncname/path.

A plain :// already gives the right URI, so maybe it suffices to drop the ://// rule?
